visualCharacteristics: BMW DLO widget (dlo.api.bmw): search panel with location/name search and filters, dealer list, HERE map; full bleed up to 1920px
contentPattern: Key/value rows = window.dloaas.api.start(config) of the source (country, language, configId, initialBrand, brands, dealerDetails, layoutMode, osatCsvPath, ...). Values are JSON literals (true, 60, null, [..], {..}, "5" = string) or plain strings. osatCsvPath (www.bmw.de DAM path) is fetched through the bmw-proxy (window.BMW_PROXY).
